meta.title: ROSE Online Global — community crafting data

excluded.name: Charming Sunglasses
excluded.reason: Not craftable or invalid material quantity

notes: Community data, originally scraped on 2026-01-04; not an official current client export.
No prices or verified current crafting success probabilities in source.
Output quantities are unknown; ingredient quantities refer to one crafting recipe attempt.
Chemical, Metal, Rare Metal, Wooden material are generic material categories; player must choose the concrete material/grade and its price.
The level field describes the equipment usage requirement, not the crafting skill level.
PAT Craft recipes may differ after the 2026-10-16 update. Shop flags are historical January 2026 metadata only, not current availability.
All 200 Gem Cutting ingredient lists matched the fresh Lucky API on 2026-10-24.
Concrete chemical and refinery item icons from ROSE Toolbox monsterDrops data, sourced roseutils.com/drops; provider timestamp 2026-10-21. Lucky and roseutils IDs belong to different namespaces.
